Wait, this is a big realization. I assumed the bar was restricted to columns 12-39, but I may never have actually tested the boundaries! Let me test LEFT at column 12 and RIGHT at column 20.
If the bar can move across the entire play area (columns 0-43), then the target position space is much larger, and the ball (columns 36-39) can be aligned with the bar in many ways.
